option_relations.rationale: Eosinophilic annular erythema (EAE) is not present in the leaves, but it matches the clinical presentation.
Wells syndrome (eosinophilic cellulitis) is present in the leaves and matches the clinical presentation.
Granuloma annulare does not match the clinical presentation of eosinophilic inflammation.
Drug-induced erythema annulare centrifugum does not match the clinical presentation of eosinophilic inflammation.
